protocol: Source-scene grouped synthetic pilot; provider distillation, no correction-label ingestion. Test calls use x-middleware-record: metadata. No test output is uploaded for training. No parameter tuning on this test.
comparisonRule: Positive paired accuracy delta, lower whole-scene bootstrap bound above zero, all adapter responses valid, no increase in false-supported claims. Preserve the original provider baseline and pinned adapter version.
limitations: Labels and passages authored with agent assistance, not independently human adjudicated.
Only source-support classification is tested; no claim about full investigator accuracy.

Related claim variants share a passage within a split; 24 cases comprise six held-out scenes, not 24 independent incidents. Case-wise Wilson intervals are descriptive and ignore clustering; paired comparison resamples whole scenes.
Mubit console kept-example counts and adapter history are authoritative; a successful request does not confirm training.
